description: The moving-source light simulation draws pulses whose centers keep moving with the source's velocity at emission while their radii grow at $c - v$ in absolute time. At the default source speed of $0.7c$, even backward-emitted light moves forward in the absolute frame.
limitations: It illustrates the proposed rule. It is not an experimental confirmation or a derivation from particle interactions, and its source code was not among the saved pages.

sources.quote: Compare light from moving and stationary sources under the proposed emission rule.
